newsitem.title: GREECE: LIBERAL FORUM SEES NO CHOICE IN SEPT ELECTION - SPOX.
newsitem.headline: LIBERAL FORUM SEES NO CHOICE IN SEPT ELECTION - SPOX.

text.p: Greek liberal voters facing a social democratic party with whose policies they disagree and a conservative party espousing populist and nationalist policies, have no choice in this election, the Liberal Forum told Reuters.

"The liberal voters have no real choice in these elections. On the one hand, they are facing a social democratic party (PASOK) with whose policies they disagree and on the other hand, a right wing party espousing dangerous populist and nationalist policies," said Liberal Forum spokesman Tassos Avradinis.
The Liberal Forum, a neo-liberal, neoconservative thinktank, is known to be close to former conservative New Democracy minister Andreas Andrianopoulos.
Forum sources told Reuters that initiatives will be taken for the creation of a modern Greek liberal party within the next few months. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
